missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Marking an unexpected case. 'Даже' is a focus particle meaning even, signalling that the next item is surprising. It stands directly before 'дети', the unlikely group it highlights.
Strategic focus: Even with negation. Here 'даже' scales down expectation before the negated verb, meaning he did not even call. It pairs naturally with 'не' to express disappointment.
Strategic focus: Highlighting a time. 'Даже' marks 'летом' as the surprising case, since cold in summer is unexpected. The particle sits right before the word it foregrounds.
Strategic focus: Even with an ability. 'Даже' raises the surprise around the verb 'петь', presenting singing in Russian as an impressive extra. It precedes the highlighted action.
Strategic focus: End-position focus. 'Даже' attaches to 'маленький ребёнок' at the end of the sentence, stressing how obvious the fact is. Placement before the noun phrase carries the emphasis.
Strategic focus: Surprising circumstance. 'Даже' flags 'в выходные' as beyond the normal expectation of working days. The particle stands just before the prepositional phrase it scales.
Strategic focus: Self-emphasis. 'Даже' before 'я' presents the speaker as the least likely person to fail, heightening the point. Fronting the particle gives it strong emphasis.
Strategic focus: Scaling a quantity. 'Даже' intensifies 'дважды', framing two readings as surprisingly many. The particle precedes the number expression it highlights.
Strategic focus: Even with an emotional state. 'Даже' marks the appearance of sadness as unexpected within the impersonal 'мне стало грустно' frame. It sits before the predicative state.

missions.phrase: Он купил даже самый дорогой билет.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Highlighting an extreme. 'Даже' stresses 'самый дорогой', presenting the most expensive ticket as the surprising choice. The particle leads the noun phrase it foregrounds.
